issue.title: Investigate intermittent multi-take Review Maximum update depth on Android devices
issue.body:
## Summary / context

On physical Android devices (not the emulator), multi-take Review on the Record tab can intermittently trigger React’s `Maximum update depth exceeded` error. After it appears, the app can slow down until reload. Filed as a follow-up from device QA on [#252](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/252) / #176 — timer overlap and pre-play scrub from that review are already fixed and verified; this crash remains.

## Current vs expected

1. Open Record for a verse.
2. Record Take 1 → play in Review (often stable).
3. Record Take 2 → play Take 2 (crash can occur on first play of Take 2).
4. Sometimes also during mid-take scrub / take switches with 2+ takes.

**Frequency:** intermittent / flaky on device; not reproduced on emulator in the same flows.

**Metro:** `Maximum update depth exceeded. This can happen when a component calls setState inside useEffect…`

**Expected:** Switching and playing multiple takes never triggers an update-depth loop or sustained UI slowdown.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Root-cause the sync setState / effect loop on the take-switch + playback path
- Fix with device-validated steps (not speculative layout/bar-count tweaks alone)
- Regression coverage where the loop can be reproduced in JS/unit tests

**Out of scope**
- Re-litigating #176 scrub UX / remux (already covered by #252)
- Broad Record-tab redesign

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Root cause identified (component stack + which state/effect cycle re-enters)
- [ ] Fix lands without regressing Review scrub / multi-take play-pause
- [ ] Physical Android QA: Record Take 1 → play → Record Take 2 → play Take 2, repeated across sessions, no update-depth error or sustained slowdown
- [ ] Emulator still green on the same flow

## Verification / test plan

1. `npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci`
2. **Android device (required):** multi-take play/switch repro above; capture Metro stack if it fails again.

## File pointers & approach

Investigate end-to-end, one layer at a time (do not shotgun):

1. `src/hooks/usePlaybackEngine.ts` — `useAudioPlayerStatus` → `setStatus` / `setPositionMs` (esp. `didJustFinish` during `replace` when switching takes)
2. `src/hooks/useVerseAudio.ts` — `state === 'playing' && playback.status === 'idle'` → `PLAYBACK_END` race vs in-flight `playTake` / `load`
3. `src/audio/createPlaybackEngine.ts` — load queue / `replace` while previous take is playing
4. `src/components/ui/PlaybackProgressBar.tsx` — `onLayout` ↔ `fittedBarCount` feedback (prior experiments were inconclusive)
5. `src/app/tabs/RecordTab.tsx` — FlatList take rows + live `positionMs` fan-out

Prior hardening on #252 (`d040166` and follow-ups: layout setState guard, status-effect deps, seek sampling) did **not** eliminate the device-only intermittent failure; treat those as incomplete, not proven root cause.

## Links

- Parent / source PR: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/252
- Related: #176 (Review scrub), #71 / #265 (multi-take Record)
- Reviewer note (JonathanSeehagen): items 2–3 OK on device; item 1 still intermittent — investigate from scratch rather than more speculative tweaks.
